Title:CONTROL OF MANUFACTURE BILL (Select Committee's Report)
MPs Speaking:Mr J. M. Jumabhoy (Minister for Commerce and Industry); Mr M. P. D. Nair (Assistant Minister to the Chief Secretary); Mr Lee Kuan Yew; Mr Lim Cher Kheng; Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


Column: 1910

CONTROL OF MANUFACTURE BILL
(Select Committee's Report)


    Mr Speaker: The remarks which I passed yesterday in regard to item 1 on the Order Paper apply with equal force to this item. Briefly, if honourable Members wish to discuss or vote against any specific clauses in this Bill in Committee, this is the time to move an amendment to the motion providing that the Bill may also be recommitted in regard to those specific clauses.

    Bill accordingly recommitted to a Committee of the whole Assembly.

    Bill considered in Committee.
